description: Hyperdrive is a secure, real-time distributed file system

sections.title: Usage

methods.name: constructor

params.name: key
params.description: Public key of an existing drive to load. May be omitted, passing `opts` in its place.

methods.description: Creates a new Hyperdrive instance. `store` must be an instance of `Corestore`.

methods.name: id
methods.description: String containing the id (z-base-32 of the public key) identifying this drive.

methods.name: key
methods.description: The public key of the Hypercore backing the drive.

methods.name: discoveryKey
methods.description: The hash of the public key of the Hypercore backing the drive.

methods.name: contentKey
methods.description: The public key of the [Hyperblobs](https://github.com/holepunchto/hyperblobs) instance holding blobs associated with entries in the drive.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Number that indicates how many modifications were made, useful as a version identifier.

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Boolean indicating if we can write or delete data in this drive.

methods.name: readable
methods.description: Boolean indicating if we can read from this drive. After closing the drive this will be `false`.

methods.name: findingPeers
methods.returns: A `done` callback to call once peer discovery has finished.
methods.description: Indicate to Hyperdrive that you're finding peers in the background, requests will be on hold until this is done.
examples:
const done = drive.findingPeers()
swarm.flush().then(done, done)

methods.name: truncate
methods.returns: Resolves once the drive and its blobs are truncated.
methods.description: Truncates the Hyperdrive to a previous version (both the file-structure reference and the blobs).
examples: await drive.truncate(drive.version - 1)

methods.name: getBlobsLength

params.name: checkout
params.description: Drive version to measure. Defaults to the current version.

methods.returns: Returns the length of the Hyperblobs instance at the time of the specified Hyperdrive version (defaults to the current version).
methods.description:
Returns the length of the Hyperblobs instance at the time of the specified
Hyperdrive version (defaults to the current version).
examples: const blobsLength = await drive.getBlobsLength()

methods.name: replicate

params.name: isInitiator
params.description: `true`/`false` to initiate replication, or an existing stream/socket to replicate over.

methods.returns: A replication stream.
methods.description: Usage example:

methods.name: update
methods.returns: `true` if the drive advanced to a new version, otherwise `false`.
methods.description: Waits for initial proof of the new drive version until all `findingPeers` are done.

methods.name: checkout
methods.returns: A read-only Hyperdrive at the requested version.
methods.description: Get a read-only snapshot of a previous version.
examples: const snapshot = drive.checkout(4)

methods.name: batch
methods.returns: A batch with the same interface as Hyperdrive; call `batch.flush()` to commit.
methods.description: Useful for atomically mutate the drive, has the same interface as Hyperdrive.

methods.name: flush
methods.returns: Resolves once the batch is committed and closed.
methods.description: Commit a batch of mutations to the underlying drive.
examples: await batch.flush()

methods.name: getBlobs
methods.returns: Returns the [Hyperblobs](https://github.com/holepunchto/hyperblobs) instance storing the blobs indexed by drive entries.
methods.description:
Returns the [Hyperblobs](https://github.com/holepunchto/hyperblobs)
instance storing the blobs indexed by drive entries.

methods.name: get

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the file to read.

methods.returns: Returns the blob at `path` in the drive.
methods.description: It also returns `null` for symbolic links.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for block to be downloaded

options.name: timeout
options.description: Wait at max some milliseconds (0 means no timeout)

methods.name: put

params.name: name
params.description: Path to write the file at.

methods.returns: Resolves once the file has been written.
methods.description: Creates a file at `path` in the drive. `options` are the same as in `createWriteStream`.
examples: await drive.put('/blob.txt', Buffer.from('example'))

methods.name: del

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the file to delete.

methods.returns: Resolves once the entry has been deleted.
methods.description: Deletes the file at `path` from the drive.
examples: await drive.del('/blob.txt')

methods.name: compare
methods.returns: Returns `0` if entries are the same, `1` if `entryA` is older, and `-1` if `entryB` is older.
methods.description: Compares two entries by their sequence number.
examples: const comparison = drive.compare(entryA, entryB)

methods.name: clear

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the file whose blob should be cleared.

methods.returns: A `{ blocks }` object when `diff` is enabled, otherwise `null`.
methods.description: Deletes the blob from storage to free up space, but the file structure reference is kept.

options.name: diff
options.description: Returned `cleared` bytes object is null unless you enable this

methods.name: clearAll
methods.returns: A `{ blocks }` object when `diff` is enabled, otherwise `null`.
methods.description: Deletes all the blobs from storage to free up space, similar to how `drive.clear()` works.

options.name: diff
options.description: Returned `cleared` bytes object is null unless you enable this

methods.name: purge
methods.returns: Resolves once both cores are purged from storage.
methods.description: Purge both cores (db and blobs) from your storage, completely removing all the drive's data.
examples: await drive.purge()

methods.name: symlink

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the symlink to create.

methods.returns: Resolves once the symlink entry has been created.
methods.description: Creates an entry in drive at `path` that points to the entry at `linkname`.
examples: await drive.symlink('/images/logo.shortcut', '/images/logo.png')

methods.name: entry

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the entry to read.

methods.returns: Returns the entry at `path` in the drive.
methods.description: `options` include:

methods.name: exists
methods.returns: Returns `true` if the entry at `path` does exists, otherwise `false`.
methods.description: Checks whether an entry exists at `path`.
examples: const exists = await drive.exists('/blob.txt')

methods.name: watch
methods.returns: Returns an iterator that listens on `folder` to yield changes, by default on `/`.
methods.description: Usage example:

methods.name: diff

params.name: length
params.description: Drive version to diff against the current `drive.version`.

params.name: folder
params.description: Path prefix to scope the diff to. Omit for the whole drive.

params.name: opts
params.description: Diff options, forwarded to the underlying Hyperbee diff stream.

methods.returns: A stream of `{ left, right }` diff entries.
methods.description: Efficiently create a stream of the shallow changes to `folder` between `version` and `drive.version`.

options.name: left
options.description: Entry in folder at drive.version for some path

options.name: right
options.description: Entry in folder at drive.checkout(version) for some path

methods.name: downloadDiff

params.name: length
params.description: Drive version to diff against the current `drive.version`.

params.name: folder
params.description: Path prefix to scope the download to. Omit for the whole drive.

methods.returns: A Download object; await `download.done()` to know when complete.
methods.description: Downloads all the blobs in `folder` corresponding to entries in `drive.checkout(version)` that are not in `drive.version`. Returns a `Download` object that resolves once all data has been downloaded:
examples:
const download = await drive.downloadDiff(version, folder)
await download.done()
download.destroy()

methods.name: downloadRange

params.name: dbRanges
params.description: Block ranges to download from the db (metadata) core.

params.name: blobRanges
params.description: Block ranges to download from the blobs core.

methods.returns: A Download object; await `download.done()` to know when complete.
methods.description: Downloads the entries and blobs stored in the ranges `dbRanges` and `blobRanges`. Returns a `Download` object that resolves once all data has been downloaded:
examples:
const download = await drive.downloadRange(dbRanges, blobRanges)
await download.done()
download.destroy()

methods.name: entries
methods.returns: Returns a read stream of entries in the drive.
methods.description: `options` are the same as `Hyperbee().createReadStream([range], [options])`.
examples: for await (const entry of drive.entries()) console.log(entry.key)

methods.name: download

params.name: folder
params.description: Path prefix to download. Defaults to the whole drive.

params.name: opts
params.description: `options` are the same as those for `drive.list(folder, [options])`.

methods.returns: A Download object; await `download.done()` to know when complete.
methods.description: Downloads the blobs corresponding to all entries in the drive at paths prefixed with `folder`. Returns a `Download` object that resolves once all data has been downloaded:
examples:
const download = await drive.download(key)
await download.done()
download.destroy()

methods.name: has

params.name: path
params.description: Path of the file or folder to check.

methods.returns: `true` if the blob (or every blob under a folder) is stored locally.
methods.description: Checks if path is saved to local store already.
examples: const exists = await drive.has('/blob.txt')

methods.name: list

params.name: folder
params.description: Path prefix to list. Defaults to the whole drive.

methods.returns: Returns a stream of all entries in the drive at paths prefixed with `folder`.
methods.description: `options` include:

options.name: recursive
options.description: Whether to descend into all subfolders or not

options.name: ignore
options.description: Ignore files and folders by name

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for block to be downloaded.

methods.name: readdir
methods.returns: Returns a stream of all subpaths of entries in drive stored at paths prefixed by `folder`.
methods.description: `options` include:

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for block to be downloaded

methods.name: mirror
methods.returns: A `MirrorDrive` instance; await it or `mirror.done()` to finish.
methods.description: Efficiently mirror this drive into another. Returns a [`MirrorDrive`](https://github.com/holepunchto/mirror-drive#api) instance constructed with `options`.
examples:
const mirror = drive.mirror(out)
await mirror.done()

methods.name: createReadStream

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the file to read.

methods.returns: Returns a stream to read out the blob stored in the drive at `path`.
methods.description: `options` include:

options.name: length
options.description: `length` overrides `end`, they're not meant to be used together

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for blocks to be downloaded

options.name: timeout
options.description: Wait at max some milliseconds (0 means no timeout)

methods.name: createWriteStream

params.name: name
params.description: Path of the file to write.

methods.returns: A writable stream; data written is stored as the file's blob.
methods.description: Stream a blob into the drive at `path`.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Extended file information i.e. arbitrary JSON value

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Waits until internal state is loaded.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Fully close this drive, including its underlying Hypercore backed datastructures.

methods.name: corestore
methods.description: The Corestore instance used as storage.

methods.name: db
methods.description: The underlying Hyperbee backing the drive file structure.

methods.name: core
methods.description: The Hypercore used for `drive.db`.

methods.name: supportsMetadata
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the drive handles or not metadata. Always `true`.

properties.name: encryptionKey
properties.description: Encryption key used to encrypt and decrypt the underlying cores.

properties.name: onwait
properties.description: Hook called when a block has to be downloaded before it can be read.

properties.name: active
properties.description: Whether the drive's cores actively maintain peer connections.

properties.name: blobs
properties.description: Corresponding blobs length, if known. Recommended to let the method figure it out.

properties.name: wait
properties.description: Whether to wait for peers before resolving. Use this or `drive.findingPeers()` to make `await drive.update()` blocking.

properties.name: wait
properties.description: Wait for the block to be downloaded.

properties.name: timeout
properties.description: Max milliseconds to wait (0 means no timeout).

typedefs.name: WriteOptions
typedefs.description: Options for writing a file (`drive.put()` and `drive.createWriteStream()`).

properties.name: executable
properties.description: Whether the blob at the path is an executable.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Extended file information, i.e. an arbitrary JSON value.

properties.name: dedup
properties.description: Reuse the existing blob if the content is unchanged (createWriteStream only).

properties.name: diff
properties.description: When enabled, returns a `{ blocks }` object reporting the bytes cleared; otherwise the result is `null`.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Extended file information, i.e. an arbitrary JSON value.

properties.name: follow
properties.description: Follow symlinks, up to 16 deep or it throws an error.

properties.name: wait
properties.description: Wait for the block to be downloaded.

properties.name: timeout
properties.description: Max milliseconds to wait (0 means no timeout).
